question: What is the total revenue for each genre?
query: SELECT g.name AS genre, ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM chinook.invoice_line AS il JOIN chinook.track AS t ON t.track_id = il.track_id JOIN chinook.genre AS g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id GROUP BY g.name

question: Which five artists generated the most revenue?
query: SELECT ar.name AS artist, ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM chinook.invoice_line AS il JOIN chinook.track AS t ON t.track_id = il.track_id JOIN chinook.album AS al ON al.album_id = t.album_id JOIN chinook.artist AS ar ON ar.artist_id = al.artist_id GROUP BY ar.artist_id, ar.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: How much have the customers of each sales support agent spent in total? Show the agent's last name.
query: SELECT e.last_name, ROUND(SUM(i.total), 2) AS revenue FROM chinook.invoice AS i JOIN chinook.customer AS c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id JOIN chinook.employee AS e ON e.employee_id = c.support_rep_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.last_name

question: For customers based in Brazil, what is the revenue by media type?
query: SELECT mt.name AS media_type, ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM chinook.invoice_line AS il JOIN chinook.invoice AS i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id JOIN chinook.customer AS c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id JOIN chinook.track AS t ON t.track_id = il.track_id JOIN chinook.media_type AS mt ON mt.media_type_id = t.media_type_id WHERE c.country = 'Brazil' GROUP BY mt.name

question: How many distinct customers have bought at least one track of each genre?
query: SELECT g.name AS genre, COUNT(DISTINCT i.customer_id) AS customers FROM chinook.invoice_line AS il JOIN chinook.invoice AS i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id JOIN chinook.track AS t ON t.track_id = il.track_id JOIN chinook.genre AS g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id GROUP BY g.name

question: How many playlists contain at least one Iron Maiden track?
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playlist_id) AS playlists FROM chinook.playlist_track AS pt JOIN chinook.track AS t ON t.track_id = pt.track_id JOIN chinook.album AS al ON al.album_id = t.album_id JOIN chinook.artist AS ar ON ar.artist_id = al.artist_id WHERE ar.name = 'Iron Maiden'

question: What is the revenue from Rock tracks in each billing country?
query: SELECT i.billing_country, ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM chinook.invoice_line AS il JOIN chinook.invoice AS i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id JOIN chinook.track AS t ON t.track_id = il.track_id JOIN chinook.genre AS g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id WHERE g.name = 'Rock' GROUP BY i.billing_country

question: For each genre, how many tracks are in the catalogue and how much revenue have they made?
query: WITH track_counts AS (SELECT genre_id, COUNT(*) AS tracks FROM chinook.track GROUP BY genre_id), revenue AS (SELECT t.genre_id, SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) AS revenue FROM chinook.invoice_line AS il JOIN chinook.track AS t ON t.track_id = il.track_id GROUP BY t.genre_id) SELECT g.name AS genre, tc.tracks, ROUND(COALESCE(r.revenue, 0), 2) AS revenue FROM chinook.genre AS g JOIN track_counts AS tc ON tc.genre_id = g.genre_id LEFT JOIN revenue AS r ON r.genre_id = g.genre_id
note: Fan trap: joining track and invoice_line once and counting tracks counts invoice lines instead.
